05 - Gameplay & 1v1 Challenges

skeep enables you to discover games via a scrollable feed and participate in turn-based 1v1 challenges against friends and randomly matched opponents.

Fair Play

All players must compete fairly. Using any method to gain an unfair advantage — including exploiting software bugs, timing manipulation, or collusion — is strictly prohibited.

Challenges & Matching

When you accept or issue a challenge, you agree to complete the game in good faith. Deliberately abandoning matches to manipulate win/loss records may result in penalties including temporary matchmaking restrictions.

Game Records

We maintain records of games played associated with your account, used for rankings, profile statistics, and improving matching algorithms. You consent to the collection and use of gameplay data as described in our Privacy Policy.

No Monetary Prizes

Unless explicitly stated otherwise, skeep challenges do not involve wagering, gambling, or prizes of real-world monetary value. Virtual rewards have no cash value and cannot be exchanged for money or goods.

06 - Messaging & Friends

skeep provides direct messaging between friends and group chat functionality. By using these features, you acknowledge and agree:

  • Messages you send are stored on our servers and may be reviewed to investigate abuse or violations
  • You must not use messaging to harass, threaten, spam, or solicit other users
  • You must not share or solicit unlawful content through chats
  • We are not responsible for the content of messages sent by other users
  • You can report abusive messages using the in-app reporting tools

You can manage your friend list, block users, and leave group chats at any time through your account settings.

skeep is supported in part by advertising. By using the free tier, you agree to the display of advertisements, which may appear as video ads, banner ads, or interstitial ads between gameplay sessions.

Personalised Advertising

We may use data about your activity, device, and general location to serve relevant advertisements. You can opt out via your device settings (iOS: Settings → Privacy → Tracking; Android: Settings → Google → Ads) or through the in-app ad preferences menu.

Third-Party Advertisers

Advertisements are served by independent third-party networks. We are not responsible for the content of third-party ads. Please report inappropriate ads using the in-app flag tool.

Children & Advertising

We do not serve behavioural advertising to users identified as under 13. For users between 13 and 17, advertising served will comply with applicable laws regarding advertising to minors.

Premium users enjoy an ad-free experience as part of their subscription. See Section 9 for details.

Pricing is displayed within the app and at skeep.app/premium. Subscriptions are billed on a recurring basis and will auto-renew unless cancelled. Payment is charged to your App Store or Google Play account upon confirmation.

Cancellation

Cancel any time through your device's subscription settings (Apple ID → Subscriptions or Google Play → Subscriptions). Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period.

Refunds

All purchases are processed by Apple or Google. Refund requests must be submitted through support.apple.com/billing (iOS) or the Google Play Help Centre (Android). We cannot directly issue refunds for platform-processed transactions.

Price Changes

We will notify you in advance of any price increases and you will have the opportunity to cancel before the new price takes effect.

Virtual Items

Virtual currency, items, or cosmetics are licensed, not sold, to you. They have no monetary value, cannot be transferred or refunded except as required by law, and may be modified or removed at any time.
